C1475.title: Itron-Centron CL200 Smart Meter Node-Tampering Experiment
C1475.summary: A 2019 IoT vulnerability case study documented a node-tampering experiment against an Itron-Centron CL200 smart meter. Researchers found in an EEPROM dump that the locally stored device ID lacked read and write protection; writing another meter's ID allowed the device to impersonate the target. Experiment logs then showed readings from two devices sharing one ID but reporting different consumption, demonstrating risks of metering-data confusion and energy theft.
